sv.title: Varnade – sedan dog sex i familjen
sv.summary: Piloten varnades för dåligt väder under flygresan med familjemedlemmarna. Kort därefter kraschade planet i vattnet. Alla sex ombord dog, skriver Mirror.

en.title: Warned – then six family members died
en.summary: The pilot was warned about bad weather during the flight with the family members. Shortly afterwards the plane crashed into the water. All six on board died, according to Mirror.
